title: Python package installs development tools as runtime dependencies
description: pip install kanbus pulls behave, black, coverage, pytest, ruff and sphinx. Move them to an optional dev extra so the CLI install is light, as the getting-started guide promises.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Acceptance check 2026-10-19 on develop 3404202a: wheel built with isolated python -m build installs 24 packages into a fresh venv (no behave, black, coverage, pytest, ruff, sphinx, litellm); dev tools live in the dev extra. Delivered by PR #447. Closing.
